pages.observation: raw23-25: GMC at left foreground and the small oncoming Jeep both appear in dynamic RGB/white alpha. Corolla stays visible in static. Deleted left road carries a strong dark shadow-like blob. Composite GMC has softened small details/edge color fringe.

raw26-28: GMC exits left with GT-consistent clipping, Jeep remains oncoming. Corolla remains in static. Dark residual on static road decreases as the GMC exits; no full target-shaped solid body remains in static.

raw29-31: small-body count is low, GMC edge remnants leave left and Jeep remains visible. Composite Jeep grille/body is blurrier and has weak contact shadow; dynamic alpha largely supports the silhouette. Main background and Corolla remain present.

raw32-34: Jeep front grows and is isolated in dynamic. Static road has no large solid Jeep body. A very thin colored stroke appears outside the main dynamic support in some views; does not form a full vehicle.
raw35-37: Jeep silhouette/placement is recognizable, front details are softer than GT. Corolla is retained in static. Weak off-body colored stroke/speckles remain visible in dynamic on black.
raw38-40: oncoming Jeep continues to be supported in dynamic and alpha. Composite wheel-contact/shadow looks weak compared with GT. No broad static-background disappearance is visible.
raw41-43: GT has a ground-connected shadow beneath Jeep; composite isolates its wheels against brighter road and begins to look floating. Static contains Corolla and parked roadside vehicles.

raw44-46: body support is strong; Jeep appears floating in composite because the ground shadow is largely missing. Static target deletion leaves mostly road but does not establish correct unobstructed GT.

raw47-49: Jeep body enlarges continuously and dynamic alpha tracks it. Weak/missing ground shadow and softened bumper/wheels remain visible. Corolla stays static and is not the large white dynamic-alpha target.

raw50-52: clear floating-body/shadow mismatch with GT, strongest ground-contact limitation in the selected bad-frame region. Vehicle body remains in dynamic, static road is comparatively bare apart from faint residuals.

raw53-55: raw53 continues missing GT-like road shadow; by raw54/55, a dark road residual appears and becomes pronounced in static. It is visible beneath the rendered body in composite and remains after dynamic removal.

raw56-58: Jeep moves off left with body/alpha clipping consistent with the field of view. Static carries a conspicuous moving shadow-like dark patch, then a narrower dark trace. Corolla remains retained.
raw59-61: Jeep exits at left. Thin dark road traces survive in static. Dynamic/alpha remaining support shrinks near the left border; foreground Corolla and scene structure persist.

raw62-64: all three are empty-body frames. Dynamic RGB and alpha look nearly black at the original display scale, with no vehicle-sized residual. Sparse low-valued exported pixels still exist, especially raw62.

raw65-67: empty-body frames retained. No large visible dynamic ghost; dynamic/alpha display is nearly black. Static/composite retain the Corolla and road/architecture, with background traffic variation not certified static.

raw68-70: empty-body frames retained and visually nearly black in dynamic/alpha. Sparse nonzero pixels remain numerically. No tail collapse or transfer of the large foreground Corolla to dynamic is visible.
raw71: final empty-body frame retained. Corolla/road/background remain visible in static/composite; dynamic/alpha are visually near black, not numerically strict zero.

model times raw23-26: pose/rays and Corolla stay fixed while a large dark blob in the left road changes its extent/location. Static alpha remains broadly opaque on the road, so this RGB residual is not simply an alpha hole.
raw27-30 times: left-road black blob shrinks and disappears while pose is fixed. Corolla and buildings remain in place. Alpha map preserves its broad road/foreground support.
raw31-34 times including anchor raw33: left road appears largely clear relative to early times. Small color/texture and background differences exist; exact invariance is not certified.
raw35-38 times: pose/Corolla geometry stays fixed. Road shows faint local shading changes; alpha remains broadly stable with small local changes, no large foreground opacity collapse.
raw39-42 times: fixed-pose composition remains present with weak local road/background variation. Corolla remains. Alpha maps retain foreground/road support.
raw43-46 times: fixed scene layout remains present; no full deleted-target body appears. Small local static changes are not treated as a GT quality score.

raw47-50 times: road and Corolla remain; faint road shading evolves. A separate distant vehicle/background content is visible in static and varies with time; complete scene staticness is not established.
raw51-54 times: dark road smear begins to develop by raw54 time. Pose and Corolla remain fixed; broad alpha support remains white.
raw55-58 times: conspicuous dark road blob grows/shifts and decays, ending in a narrow trace. Alpha stays broadly opaque at this location. Strong evidence against absolute static RGB invariance.
raw59-62 times: narrow trace fades and left road becomes clearer. Pose/Corolla and broad static-alpha structure remain fixed. Minor background traffic/content variation persists.
raw63-66 times: no large dark left-road blob; source pixels still have small static color/alpha and distant-background differences. Corolla remains retained.
raw67-70 times: fixed-pose geometry/Corolla persist; alpha retains broad support. This is counterfactual pose/time imagery without matched GT.
raw71 time: fixed pose and Corolla remain; no large left-road blob. Full review does not establish strict static RGB or alpha invariance.

detail_pages.observation: Actual crop review confirms low-resolution Jeep body/grille blur and edge softness in raw29/30/33, and strong dynamic alpha silhouette. Road is available after deletion, but correct unobstructed reconstruction cannot be judged without GT.

GT has broad contact/cast shadow connecting Jeep to road. Composite crops lack most of that shadow and render detached-looking wheels; this is clearly visible at native pixel duplication, not inferred only from PSNR.

Deletion removes solid GMC/Jeep bodies but retains dark shadow-like road material. GMC has visible small-detail blur/edge fringe; Jeep body is reconstructed while static road residue causes a changing shadow patch.
Same pose and ROI: black road residual at raw23 time, clear road at raw33 anchor, black residual at raw55/56 times. Alpha in the ROI stays broadly near white; road RGB is explicitly time dependent.

contact_policy: No source modification, image scaling, normalization, exposure/color adjustment, filtering, premasking or hash/fingerprint computation. Labels outside image tiles. Grayscale converted to three identical RGB channels for paste only.
detail_policy: Crops repeat each original pixel 2x/3x with no interpolation, filtering, exposure, normalization or premasking. Statistics count existing decoded 8bit PNG values; copied FP32 summaries remain authoritative for raw near-zero means.
generation_receipt_note: contact_generation_receipt.json records the pre-review generation state; this coverage receipt records the subsequently completed tool-viewed review.
